svg.title: PIHTI electrical connections — layout draft
svg.desc: Operator-authored reference: Kikusui heats the cathode, the preanode supply raises preanode 100 volts above cathode, GP060-3 raises anode 60 volts above preanode, and Matsusada biases the target minus 600 volts relative to cathode. Wiring and readings must be confirmed at the rig.
